audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is keccak256 collision-resistant and correctly implemented?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: The property concerns keccak256 for EL block hash computation and header integrity. While Prysm has a keccak256 implementation (crypto/hash/hash.go, crypto/keystore/keccak256.go), it is used for CL keystore operations and not for EL block validation. The EL-specific usage context (block forgery, header verification) does not apply to Prysm's CL usage.

code_scope.reason: EL-only property context; Prysm's keccak256 is for CL keystore, not EL block validation

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is withdrawal amount scaled correctly by 10^9 (Gwei to Wei)?
audit_items.skip_reason: Component mismatch: Gwei-to-Wei scaling (withdrawal.amount * 10^9) is an EL process_withdrawals concern that modifies account balances. Prysm's ProcessWithdrawals (beacon-chain/core/blocks/withdrawals.go) is CL-side withdrawal processing that validates expected withdrawals against beacon state, not ETH balance manipulation with unit conversion.

code_scope.reason: EL-only property; Prysm's ProcessWithdrawals is CL-side, does not perform Gwei-to-Wei conversion
